pr_title: Allow workday sensor to be configured without a country
pr_body:
## Proposed change
Allow the configuration of the workday sensor without a country. This allows for an empty starting slate of holidays that can then be built up with the "Add holidays" option.

This is useful to those (like me) with a holiday schedule that doesn't match well with the official holidays of my region. Instead of having to determine which holidays to remove and which to add, it is easier to simply start with a blank slate and add the holidays I will have from the list provided by HR.

issue_context.title: Workday Sensor Doesn't Respect `add_holidays` when `holiday` is not among the `excludes` list
issue_context.body:
### The problem

The Workday sensor configuration does not work as described in the documentation. If `holiday` is not in the `excludes` list, then holidays added with the `add_holiday` key are not respected: https://github.com/home-assistant/core/blob/affea9a3057c52174474e641cb96246f9b722645/homeassistant/components/workday/binary_sensor.py#L201-L202
However, such an example is given [in the docs](https://www.home-assistant.io/integrations/workday/#full-examples):

> This example excludes Saturdays and Sundays but not pre-configured holidays. Two custom holidays are added.
> 
> ```yaml
> # Example 1 configuration.yaml entry
> binary_sensor:
>   - platform: workday
>     country: US
>     workdays: [mon, tue, wed, thu, fri]
>     excludes: [sat, sun]
>     add_holidays:
>       - "2020-02-24"
>       - "2020-04-25"
> ```

To reproduce:
1. set the configuration included below (alter the value under `add_holidays` to the current date)
2. start Home Assistant
3. observe that the `binary_sensor.workday_sensor` is on, not off

### What version of Home Assistant Core has the issue?

core-2023.2.0.dev0

### What was the last working version of Home Assistant Core?

_No response_

### What type of installation are you running?

Home Assistant Core

### Integration causing the issue

Workday

### Link to integration documentation on our website

https://www.home-assistant.io/integrations/workday/

### Diagnostics information

_No response_

### Example YAML snippet

```yaml
binary_sensor:
  - platform: workday
    country: US
    province: PA
    workdays: [mon, tue, wed, thu, fri]
    excludes: [sat, sun]
    add_holidays:
      - "2022-01-16"

logger:
  default: info
  logs:
    homeassistant.components.workday: debug
```

From what you are describing, I would say that this component does work as expected, i.e. if you do not exclude "holiday"s from workdays then adding any custom holidays should not turn the binary sensor off on those days.
Should we move this to https://github.com/home-assistant/home-assistant.io/issues instead, and remove or fix that example?

Definitely either the code needs to be changed or the documentation needs to be changed. Maybe there's another integration that does what I need, but I think that the functionality that I described is useful. 

My goal is to use the workday sensor for weekdays vs. weekends and also add custom holidays; I've found it easier to just add my company's list of days off than it is to figure out the difference between the sets of "holidays as defined by this integration" and "holidays as defined by my company" and add the appropriate `add_holidays` **and** `remove_holidays`. I hope it's clear that the latter requires a non-trivially larger amount of work than the former.

Ah, so you want to add only custom non-workdays, but not the public holidays of the country you live in.

For your particular use-case I would imagine that you could now use the new local calendar? You could define a "weekday" event on this calendar, repeating daily for Mondays-Fridays, and no end of the repeat. And then you can manually go through the year and remove all of entries that fall into the "company's list of days off". And then you could implement a template binary sensor that uses this calendar's events as triggers to change its state.
If the company's list of days off is very short, you might even be able to achieve all this with just a template binary sensor and some date comparison magic.

Yes, exactly. I would rather use the workday sensor's functionality because the trigger-based template sensor seems more fragile: will there be a flicker between the workday ending Monday at 23:59:59 and starting Tuesday at 00:00:00?

I see @karliemeads has put up #86056 for this, but I think it doesn't make sense to ask for a country name when then explicitly not using that country's holidays, so I will comment over there about that.

(Part of the reason to continue using the workday integration is that the scheduling integration I use (https://github.com/nielsfaber/scheduler-component and https://github.com/nielsfaber/scheduler-card) integrates with the workday sensor automatically (https://github.com/nielsfaber/scheduler-card#choosing-the-days).)

Here I'm following the pattern from the `province` value, but it makes sense to change from `get()` to `[]` if it will always be set. However, I think that the `| None` type hint should remain, since `None` _is_ an acceptable value for the `country` with this changeset.

`province` key is missing if the province is not set. For example not all countries have province/state/etc.
`country` key should never be missing. It should be set to `None` if selected as such
In OptionsFlow we should abort directly if no country is specified instead of loading a form with nothing in it.

I’m not sure what you mean by this. When I configure a workday sensor with no country and then chose to configure it again, it moves directly to the options form with the workday exclude, days offset, etc.
